title: Overview
description: An introduction to Tokio, its features (fast, reliable, scalable), and its core components including the scheduler, reactor, and asynchronous I/O primitives.

title: Getting Started
description: A quick-start guide for new users, covering project setup and a simple TCP echo server example to get up and running quickly.

title: Tasks & Scheduling
description: Explore Tokio's core concepts for managing asynchronous operations, including task spawning, synchronization, and timing.

title: Spawning & Managing Tasks
description: Learn how to create and manage concurrent tasks using `spawn`, `spawn_local`, and `spawn_blocking`. Understand the `JoinHandle` for retrieving task results and `JoinSet` for managing groups of tasks.

title: Synchronization Primitives
description: A guide to Tokio's synchronization tools, including channels (mpsc, oneshot, watch, broadcast) and state synchronization types (Mutex, RwLock, Semaphore, Barrier).

title: Time, Delays, and Timeouts
description: Learn how to work with time-based operations in Tokio, including `sleep` for delays, `interval` for periodic tasks, and `timeout` for bounding execution time.

title: The Runtime
description: Understand the Tokio runtime, its schedulers (multi-threaded and current-thread), and how to configure it using the `Builder` API and `#[tokio::main]` macro.

title: Asynchronous I/O
description: An introduction to Tokio's non-blocking I/O model, covering the core `AsyncRead` and `AsyncWrite` traits and the various I/O resources available.

title: Networking
description: Guidance on using Tokio's asynchronous networking primitives, including TCP (`TcpListener`, `TcpStream`), UDP (`UdpSocket`), and Unix Domain Sockets.

title: Filesystem
description: Learn how to perform asynchronous file operations with `tokio::fs`, including reading, writing, and manipulating files and directories.

title: Child Processes
description: A guide to spawning and managing asynchronous child processes using `tokio::process::Command`.

title: OS Signals
description: Learn how to handle Unix and Windows OS signals asynchronously within a Tokio application.

title: Configuration
description: Advanced configuration options for tailoring Tokio to specific needs, including feature flags and platform-specific settings.

title: Feature Flags
description: A detailed breakdown of Tokio's feature flags, guiding both application and library authors on how to minimize dependencies and compiled code.

title: Platform Support
description: Details on officially supported platforms, including specific considerations for WASM environments.

title: Unstable Features
description: Instructions on how to opt-in to and use unstable features, with the understanding that their APIs may change.

title: Project Information
description: Information about the Tokio project, including how to contribute, where to find help, and release details.

title: Contributing & Support
description: Guidelines for contributing to the Tokio project, MSRV policy, release schedule, LTS policy, and links to community resources.

title: Changelog
description: A detailed log of changes, fixes, and additions for each version of the Tokio crate.
